observed_defaults.note: These contexts are distinct. Preview and preset values are not universal final conversion defaults.

implementation_observations.media: FFmpeg command builder with container-specific video/audio codecs, segmented and multi-input/output job kinds; preview transcodes separately cached; queue and database IPC surfaces present.
implementation_observations.image: Sharp pipeline; HEIC decode through heic-convert; raster transforms, compression, effects, metadata, compositing; HEIF encoding branch may use FFmpeg/libx265 and fallback AV1 HEIF.
implementation_observations.pdf: pdf-lib structural edits; pdfjs text/render extraction; document conversion uses print/render paths, page selection, ZIP multi-output.
implementation_observations.documents: Markdown-it/Turndown/Mammoth/docx render/export; JSON/YAML/XML/CSV/LOG parsing/rendering; off-main utility worker operations.
implementation_observations.persistence: SQLite dependency and conversions/history/drafts/presets APIs observed. No claim of crash-safe behavior or schema completeness.
